title: Nokware a Ɔhwehwɛ Pii
intro: Wɔ bere a na nimdeɛ a wonni ne atoro anyame som akata so mu no, gyidi akwantu a emu dɔ bi daa adi. Saa onipa yi kasa tiaa wɔn man mu gyinapɛn ahorow, na ɔde ahotoso a enhinhim hwehwɛɛ Nokware Ɔbɔadeɛ Baako no. Siesie wo ho sɛ wobɛda ɔkra bi a n’agyapade kɔ so kanyan nnipa ɔpepem pii no nipasu adi.
clues: Mibisabisaa ɔsoro nipadua no ho kyim, hwehwɛɛ nokware Awurade a ɔbɔ ne nyinaa na ɔhwɛ so no.
Wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ memfi me kurom, na mentu kwan nkɔ asaase bi a Allah ahyira so.
Mekasa tiaa me nkurɔfo ahoni, na migyinaa wɔn ahuhude so tẽẽ denam wɔn a mibubuu so.
Me nkorɔfo na wɔtow me guu ogya a ano yɛ den mu, nanso ɛbɛyɛɛ onwini ne asomdwoe maa me denam Allah ahyɛde so.
Wɔde ahyɛde a ɛne sɛ memfa m’abakan a medɔ no no mmɔ afɔre, sɔhwɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ mɛbrɛ me ho ase koraa no sɔɔ me hwɛe.
Me ne me babarima no maa Ɔsom Fie a edi kan wɔ Asase so, kronkronbea ma adesamma nyinaa no fapem so.

arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham." (21:69)
